hook: Your white spacesuit would come back from the Moon filthy and dark.
title: Moon Dust Turned Apollo 17 Suits Dark
description:
Apollo 17's Gene Cernan and Harrison Schmitt came back with suits coated in lunar dust. The dust was sticky and clung to suits and tools. It was one of the real headaches of walking on the Moon.

#Shorts #Space #Apollo
comment_prompt: Would you walk on the Moon? Yes or no
